column1: # Tolbi in the rain: the festival goes on while the city strains.

column3:
Turn your back on the
Spring and toss a coin.{page_break}People say it grants
wishes. Lately it only
takes them.{end_wait}
A Lucky Medal is worth\nmore than a coin...{page_break}but nobody has had\nluck in this rain.{end_wait}
Ah... I suppose luck\nwent out with the sun.\nHow about you?{end_wait}
I keep losing coins,\nbut I can't stop!\nWhat is wrong with me?{end_wait}

The festival goes on,
rain or no rain.{page_break}Babi's soldiers say
stopping it would
cause panic.{end_wait}

Colosso is held in the
colosseum, where the
crowd is driest.{page_break}Get there early.
The rain has people
fighting for a seat.{end_wait}
Tryouts started at the\ncolosseum today.{page_break}I'll watch the finals,\nif the roof holds up.{end_wait}

Colosso should have
started today. Where
is everyone?{page_break}I saw Babi's bodyguards
wandering the streets.{page_break}If our leader has
fallen ill, nobody
will say so.{end_wait}

Babi was old when I
was born. I am 65
now.{page_break}A man cannot live
that long. Something
is not right.{end_wait}
Can anyone live to be\nmore than 100 years old?{end_now}
Hmm. Babi is a lot\nolder than 100.\nThat is what worries me.{end_wait}

Perhaps. Then what
about Tolbi's ruler,
Babi?{page_break}He is at least 50
years older than I am!{end_wait}

Whee! The festival!
It does not stop for
the rain!{page_break}What will I buy with
Mama's money? Not
bread. Bread is gone.{end_wait}
Waah! She said that money\nwas for both of us!{end_wait}
Colosso souvenirs!\nSomething to remember\nthe flood by!{end_wait}
Snacks and drinks, double\nprice! The rain ruined\nhalf the stock!{end_wait}

I decided not to fight
in Colosso after all.{page_break}The contestants are
huge, and they look
hungry.{end_wait}
Tolbi's festival is\nhuge! If you ignore\nthe rain, it is lovely.{end_wait}

We came a day too late
and now the colosseum
is full.{page_break}Nowhere to go but
the street, and the
street is a river.{end_wait}
Children love\nsouvenirs, don't they?{end_now}

You like them too.
Don't hide it! I
used to buy them all.{page_break}Now the wife says
we cannot afford it.{end_wait}
Hmph! You say that\nbecause your parents\nnever bought you any!{end_wait}
Be patient, little one.{end_wait}
I will buy you\nsomething better later.{end_wait}
{text_effect:4}Waah!{reset_text_style} I am hungry!\nBuy me sweets! Please\nbuy me sweets!{end_wait}

Every inn is full, so I
sleep here.{page_break}This archway keeps
the rain off me. It is
almost a bed.{end_wait}
Tourists are not the\nonly ones who love\nColosso. We need it!{end_wait}
The trials start at the\ncolosseum today.{page_break}Win and you eat well\nuntil the finals.{end_wait}
The trials are fine,\nbut the finals are\nwhat everyone needs.{end_wait}

There have not been
any problems lately...{page_break}so why do Babi's
soldiers look so
scared?{end_wait}
Every year I get older\nwhile Babi stays the\nsame.{end_wait}
What if Babi is a\ndifferent man now,{page_break}and no one has dared\nto tell us?{end_wait}
I'm the oldest, so I\nshould keep the\nallowance.{end_wait}
Mama told us to share.\nDoes my brother not\nremember?{end_wait}
We have to sell these\nsouvenirs before the\nrain washes us out.{end_wait}
They sell these at the\ncolosseum too, but\nhere they are dry!{end_wait}
I saw the people who\nwill fight. They look\nhungry and angry.{end_wait}
Tolbi is not like Xian.\nHere, even the rain\nis loud.{end_wait}

I should not say this,
but I grew afraid to
watch Colosso,{page_break}so I overslept
on purpose.{end_wait}

The stalls along the
street smell wonderful.{page_break}If my children
buy some, I will get
a bite too.{end_wait}
Why do children want\nsuch terrible food?{page_break}I am not buying that!\nNo matter what!{end_wait}
Those sweets smell great.\nI am not moving until\nyou buy me some.{end_wait}

I have guarded our
spot, but it is hardly
worth it.{page_break}I hope my friends get
here before the water
does.{end_wait}
Hey, have you seen\nanyone who looks like\nthis?{end_now}
Babi must be nearby!!!{end_wait}
Where is Babi? He\nis not here. Let's\nlook over there.{end_wait}

Colosso reaches its
peak any minute now.{page_break}Hurry to the colosseum
before the crowd turns
ugly!{end_wait}
Are you watching the\nfinals? They may have\nstarted already!{end_wait}

My family saved me a
seat at the colosseum.{page_break}Still, we should go.
The streets are not
safe after dark.{end_wait}

I thought something had
happened to Babi...{page_break}He appeared at the
finals, so it was
nothing. Probably.{end_wait}
The colosseum was too\nfull to get in. I only\ndid the Lucky Guess.{end_wait}
Nobody has noticed,\nbut this year's festival\nhas gone on too long.{end_wait}
It's the finals!\nSeven warriors remain!\nOnly one will live!{end_wait}
Waah! My brother spent\nall our money on the\nLucky Guess!{end_wait}
Colosso souvenirs!\nLast chance! Thirty\npercent off!{end_wait}
The finals are long.\nBuy food now, before\nit runs out!{end_wait}
The trials were\ngripping.{page_break}The finals will be\nbetter. I cannot wait.{end_wait}
I have seats to the\nfinals. They cost far\ntoo much.{end_wait}
I overslept again and\nthe colosseum is full!{page_break}Maybe I should buy\nseats from a scalper...{end_wait}

There are always
scalpers at the finals.{page_break}They only cheat people
who come in from the
countryside.{end_wait}
The finals are about\nto start. It is\nkind of sad.{end_wait}
Wait until Colosso\nends, like a good\nchild.{end_wait}
Prices drop when Colosso\nends, so buying now\nis foolish!{end_wait}
They said they would\nbuy it after Colosso.\nI doubt it.{end_wait}

The finals start today.
I hope my buddy is
all right.{page_break}If you need a seat,
buy a ticket from
him.{end_wait}
I have to get to the\ncolosseum...{page_break}What if I miss the\nheight of the battle?{end_wait}
A battle to the death\nwith 7 strong warriors.\nHow exciting!{end_wait}
The finals start on\nBabi's signal.\nI love that part!{end_wait}
If nothing is wrong\nwith Babi, why were\nthe soldiers so upset?{end_wait}
I could still buy a\nseat from a scalper,\nbut I hate that.{end_wait}
However I add it up,\nthis festival is longer\nthan last year's!{end_wait}
We could win big if we\nspent our rent on the\nLucky Guess.{end_wait}
Mama, why did you\nlisten to my brother?{end_wait}
We cannot sell anything\nonce the finals end.\nSell it now!{end_wait}
The final push!\nWhatever does not sell\nwill rot in the rain!{end_wait}
Fighting in Colosso\ntakes real power.\nI could never do it.{end_wait}
They sell finals seats\nat the entrance.\nIt is robbery!{end_wait}
It is supposed to be\nfree. Buying seats from\nscalpers is a shame.{end_wait}
When Colosso ends, our\nlives can go back to\nnormal. If they can.{end_wait}
Festivals are so\nexpensive. My purse is\nempty!{end_wait}
Mom, you said you were\nout of money, but\nyou are not!{end_wait}
Today is a big day for\nus scalpers. Right,\nbuddy?{end_wait}

This year's Colosso
has ended.{page_break}Come back next year,
if Tolbi is still
here.{end_wait}

Back to our quiet lives
now that Colosso is
over?{page_break}Quiet, and wet, and
hungry.{end_wait}
You were in the finals,\nweren't you?{end_now}
I was moved by how\ndetermined you were,\ndespite your size.{end_wait}
You weren't? You look\njust like that warrior.{end_wait}

With the revelers gone
the town feels empty.{page_break}The days after the
festival are lonely.
Rainier, too.{end_wait}
I had no luck in the\nLucky Guess. Maybe the\nrain will ease next year.{end_wait}
It is so quiet! The\nnoise of Colosso\nfeels like a dream!{end_wait}
Yay! It's easy to run\nwith no one around.\nExcept for the puddles.{end_wait}
Ha ha! This is fun! My\nbig brother is being\nnice to me again!{end_wait}
I will be back to do\nbusiness next year,\nif there is a next year.{end_wait}
These are leftovers,\nbut have some. Nobody\nelse wants them!{end_wait}

The festival ran longer
this year, so I made
more money.{page_break}I would rather have
had the sun.{end_wait}
The spectators have gone,\nso we have to clean up.\nWhat a mess!{end_wait}
Imagine having Colosso\nall year long!{page_break}Whew. That would be\na lot of work for us.{end_wait}

All the warriors who
win fame in the finals
become Babi's soldiers.{page_break}That is why his
soldiers are so
strong.{end_wait}

No ships are sailing
the Karagol, are they?{page_break}How will the tourists
get home in this
weather?{end_wait}

Since Colosso ended so
dramatically, the Lucky
Guess goes to...{page_break}Dang. A little more
luck and I would have
been rich.{end_wait}
The calm after the\nstorm is nice too.\nOnly this storm stays.{end_wait}
Tolbi's main street\nis so wide open!{end_wait}
My brother was mean to\nme during the festival.\nHe changed completely!{end_wait}
Every year I try to sell\neverything and fail.{page_break}How do I carry all\nthis home in the rain?{end_wait}
How can we get home if\nsea monsters block the\ncrossing?{end_wait}
